topic: Decide which board game to play at game night

scenario.topic: Decide which board game to play at game night
scenario.opening_question: When picking a board game for tonight, what matters most to you: game length, complexity, or how competitive it gets?

options.name: Ticket to Ride
options.upside: Easy to learn with strategic depth and a satisfying race to complete routes.
options.tradeoff: Can feel slower paced if one player takes a long time to decide moves.
options.concern: Less direct competition, which might feel less exciting for highly competitive players.
options.best_for: players who want a balanced mix of strategy and casual play within a reasonable time.

options.name: 7 Wonders Duel
options.upside: Highly competitive and fast-paced with deep strategic choices tailored for two players.
options.tradeoff: Steeper learning curve and longer setup might slow down the start of the night.
options.concern: Might feel overwhelming if either player prefers simpler rules or casual play.
options.best_for: players who prioritize intense competition and strategic depth in a short time.

options.name: Patchwork
options.upside: Quick to learn and play, perfect for a relaxed, light-hearted experience.
options.tradeoff: Limited direct interaction might make it less engaging for those wanting competitive tension.
options.concern: May feel too simple or repetitive for players wanting a deeper strategic challenge.
options.best_for: players who want a casual, quick game with minimal setup and rules.

options.name: Codenames: Duet
options.upside: Cooperative gameplay fosters teamwork and quick rounds, great for a lighter, social vibe.
options.tradeoff: Short playtime means you might want to play multiple rounds to fill the evening.
options.concern: Less competitive since it’s cooperative, which might not satisfy competitive players.
options.best_for: players who want a fast, cooperative game that emphasizes communication.

shared_context: There are exactly 2 participants playing tonight.
The game night is scheduled for about 2 hours.
Both players prefer games that are engaging but not too complicated to learn on the spot.

personas.name: Ivan
personas.background: I prefer cooperative games because I get anxious in highly competitive settings and enjoy teamwork.
personas.private_goal: To have a relaxed, cooperative game night that minimizes stress and fosters communication.

personas.name: Xena
personas.background: I enjoy quick, casual games that are easy to set up and allow for light-hearted fun after a busy day.
personas.private_goal: To play a casual, low-complexity game that can be finished quickly and keeps the mood light and enjoyable.
